Tell me about LEO Innovation Lab

source: TomBot LEO

LEO Innovation Lab was an independent healthtech incubator established by LEO Pharma.

Product leads were essentially mini-CEOs for each venture, and I worked there from 2016 to 2020 across three product roles:

  • TREAT: Parachuted into underperforming flagship product, turned it around, then recommended closure
  • Skincoach: Built an app for terminally ill cancer patients - some of most meaningful work I've done
  • Diagnosis App: Led ML and computer vision team

I also drove adoption of prototyping, and direct user interviews across the organisation, and changed the all-hands format from sharing vanity stats to sharing mistakes.

The innovation lab model ultimately wasn't sustainable, but it was a formative career moment - accelerated learning, brilliant peers, rapid iteration.

Want to know more? Ask about TREAT, Skincoach, the Diagnosis App, or why the innovation lab model didn't survive.

Direct answers

  • BetterVisitBot: a pre-briefing chatbot for doctor consultations. Worked with GPs to prototype it. I hid a dermatologist in an adjacent room to simulate a consultation chatbot. Right idea, too early. Now it isn't.
